Move the red car (AA) to the exit on the right.
Specify moves in the format: 'F+1 K+1 M-1 C+3 H+2 ...'
where the letter is the vehicle and +/- number is spaces to move right/left or down/up.
Walls are marked with an 'x'. Cars cannot move through walls, and walls cannot be moved.
A car oriented vertically can only move up and down, a car oriented horizontally can only move left and right.

Board:
..F.BB
..FCCC
AAFGHI
EDDGHI
E....J
....xJ


When you are done, put your final answer between <answer> and </answer> tags.

**Key obstacles on row 2:** F at (2,2), G at (2,3), H at (2,4), I at (2,5)

**Critical bottleneck:** Column 5 is fully packed (C, I, I, J, J from rows 1-5), so I need to work from the other side to free up space.

Here's my plan:

| Step | Move | Reason |
|------|------|--------|
| 1 | E+1 | Clear (3,0) so D can shift |
| 2 | D-1 | Clear (3,2) so F can drop |
| 3 | F+3 | Clear (2,2); F drops to rows 3-5 |
| 4 | C-3 | Clear (1,5); C slides left |
| 5 | B-1 | Clear (0,5) so I can rise |
| 6 | I+2 | Clear (2,5); I rises to rows 0-1 |
| 7 | G+1 | Clear (2,3) |
| 8 | H+1 | Clear (2,4) |
| 9 | A+4 | A slides to the exit! |

**Verification of final position:**
```
...BBI
CCC..I
....AA    ← A exits here!
DDFGH.
E.FGHJ
E.F.xJ
```

<answer>E+1 D-1 F+3 C-3 B-1 I+2 G+1 H+1 A+4</answer>
